A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GCR research. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original GCR benchmark results, efficiency measurements, ablations, parameter analyses and zero-shot transfer experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds construction-efficiency measurements, FreebaseQA results, stratified evaluations and logical-coherence assessment.

M1.justification: The BFS-to-KG-Trie construction, constrained decoder, fine-tuning objective and beam-search/general-LLM aggregation remain unchanged. Appendix B elaborates optional construction, caching and deployment strategies without establishing a revised evaluated GCR algorithm.

E1.justification: v2 adds zero-shot evaluation on 100 FreebaseQA questions, extending question coverage on the existing Freebase KG. WebQSP, CWQ, CSQA and MedQA remain; the addition does not introduce a new KG domain.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds UniKGQA, reporting WebQSP Hit/F1 of 77.2/72.2 and CWQ Hit/F1 of 51.2/49.1. Existing comparator sets are otherwise retained. Newly discussed methods in Appendix A are not additional evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: v2 adds a 1–5 LLM scoring protocol for logical coherence and construction-efficiency evaluations across path lengths, pipeline stages and 1/4/10/20 processing threads. It also introduces answer-count and reasoning-hop breakdowns. The original QA splits, training recipe and main L=2, K=10 settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained component, model, constraint and parameter studies, Appendices B and F.2–F.5 add construction-overhead and parallel-scaling analyses, multi-answer and multi-hop comparisons with RoG, logical-coherence evaluation and failure cases involving irrelevant paths and incomplete KGs.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The added mean timings and coherence score do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Main GCR benchmark scores remain unchanged, but v2 adds FreebaseQA scores, construction timings, stratified F1 results, failure examples and a mean coherence score of 3.9/5. Table 4 also changes the Llama-3.1-70B general-LLM Hit/F1 from 90.24/71.19 to 89.85/71.47 under the same reported setting.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2.1 adds construction-complexity reasoning: O(E^L) time and O(E^L × T) space, with E denoting average edges per entity and T tokens per path. The original probabilistic formulations and training objective are retained; no substantial new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the claims of KG-grounded zero-hallucination reasoning, complementary specialized/general LLMs, state-of-the-art KGQA performance and transfer to unseen KGs. Additional evidence does not redefine these central contributions.

C2.justification: New Appendices F.5 and G explicitly acknowledge that KG-valid paths can be irrelevant and that incomplete or incorrect KGs undermine answer correctness. They explain concrete failures and computational limits for longer paths. This substantially qualifies v1's predominantly successful-case discussion and brief medical-domain limitation.

D1.justification: Appendix B adds CPU/memory specifications and construction-stack details, including Virtuoso SPARQL, Pickle, spaCy, ColBERTv2, the tokenizer and MARISA Trie. Figure 8 supplies the new coherence-evaluation prompt. Existing training hyperparameters and resource measurements are retained, although the coherence judge model and sample size remain unspecified.

R1.justification: Appendix A substantially expands the prior-work discussion with GFM-RAG, Plan-on-Graph, Debate on Graph, SymAgent and temporal-KG research. The retrieval-versus-agent framing remains, but positioning now covers additional graph models, planning approaches and methods addressing KG incompleteness.

P1.justification: Most original main-text prose and section order are retained. v2 adds localized clarifications, organizes the expanded appendix into lettered sections, and updates authorship, affiliations and acknowledgments while adding an Impact Statement. The scientific additions do not amount to a wholesale narrative rewrite.

P2.justification: The main paper changes from a single-column format to an ICML two-column layout, extensively resizing and relocating displays. v2 adds a cache schematic, evaluation-prompt figure and construction, subgroup and failure-case tables, and extends Table 6 with FreebaseQA. Existing parameter-analysis plots are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially improves assessment of the central efficiency and faithfulness claims. Where v1 lacked construction-cost accounting and explicit treatment of KG-grounded failures, v2 provides stage timings, failure evidence and clear limitations concerning incorrect, incomplete or irrelevant KG information. These address important applicability and interpretation gaps. Broad headline claims and the underspecified coherence evaluation remain weaknesses, but the added evidence and qualifications provide a substantial net improvement.
